gen-gf-gugi-gf-arsenal: Gugi's tall lowercase nearly climbs to the capitals, with every stroke drawn flat. Arsenal, a sans with a mellow swing in its stroke weights, is the one that carries a paragraph, while Gugi simply announces it.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-arsenal-sc: Gugi comes in bold and distinctive, its terminals cut open so the counters spill outward, drawn with one fixed nib width. Arsenal SC adds a faint, tight-fitting modulation.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-asimovian: Bold and distinctive, Gugi pushes its tall lowercase almost up to the capitals, with open terminals and curves that match its stems. Asimovian, a sans-serif, takes over for the reading.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-basic: Gugi cuts every letter at a single depth, like an engraver's tool that never digs deeper in places. And Basic, a low-key sans-serif with a gentle bump up to capitals, would carry a long passage without a snag.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-cal-sans: Approachable and modern, Cal Sans has short ascenders and a tall x-height. Over a long stretch it reads as a sans-serif with one stroke width, steady and friendly, while Gugi stays loud above it.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-carlito: Gugi draws each glyph with one-tip simplicity, its tall lowercase nearly matching the capitals, with open terminals and curves true to the stems. Carlito, a sans-serif with tight spacing and open round letters, settles in beneath.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-courier-prime: Tall lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals gives Gugi its distinctive look, with open terminals and curves matching the stems. And Courier Prime, a monospace with the steady line of a drafting pen, brings precision to the pair.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-days-one: Chunky tubes of letters, tall and bold. Gugi shouts in constant-width strokes while Days One, a sans with rope-ladder spacing and an x-height that fills the line, backs it up with similar weight.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-epunda-sans: Epunda Sans reads with oversized e and a counters and lots of daylight inside its curves, trimmed close at the edges. Gugi's spaghetti-like strokes sit above it, and the sans body could take a slightly larger size.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-farro: Farro is a plain sans with compressed ascenders and no stroke contrast at all. Farro does well at a modest size, while Gugi brings the tall, open-terminal swagger up top.
